description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact Anthropic brand colors (#141413, #faf9f5, #b0aea5, #e8e6dc for backgrounds/text; #d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d for accents), (2) Use python-pptx to open qbr_deck_draft.pptx from marketing/campaigns/q4_2024/, (3) Replace all slide backgrounds with brand dark (#141413) or light (#faf9f5) colors, (4) Apply Poppins (or Arial fallback) to ALL text runs at 24pt or larger — including the exact boundary case of 24pt on Slide 3 — and Lora (or Georgia fallback) to all text below 24pt, (5) Replace all text colors with appropriate brand colors, (6) Replace all non-text shape fills with the accent colors cycling in strict orange→blue→green order (#d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d), and (7) Save the result as qbr_deck_branded.pptx. The proprietary traps are: the 24pt heading boundary (not 18pt or 36pt), the exact hex values that must match precisely, and the strict orange→blue→green cycling rule for shapes.
